predictions.headline: Australia's round-one win over New Zealand makes them the pick against Fiji
predictions.text: Australia to win on the draw-removed market at 19:05 AEST. Australia beat New Zealand 24-22 in the tournament opener, with James Tedesco captaining from fullback and Sam Walker and Tom Dearden forming a new halves pairing after Reece Walsh, Mitchell Moses and Liam Martin were ruled out. Fiji beat Cook Islands 40-12 with Waqa Blake making 188 run metres, Caleb Navale 202 and Sunia Turuva 169, and Apisai Koroisau leads an unchanged side. Beating New Zealand by two is a stronger form line than beating Cook Islands by 28.
